description: Propeller efficiency and stall-speed data for the 8 priority aircraft. Graded observed/derived/estimated. Prop efficiency default 0.80 where primary is missing. Stall mostly IAS from manuals or secondary; CAS/EAS rare.

propeller_efficiency.notes: Use default for German types and Spitfire I/V. Prefer NACA series for P-47.

p47.source: NACA L4L07 (P-47C Curtiss) and NACA WR L-594 / MR L5G09a (P-47D Hamilton Standard 6507A-2)

p51d.notes: No dedicated primary η table; derive from Wright Field power/speed if needed

german.notes: No primary measured installation curves located for Bf 109 E/G or Fw 190 A/D

p51d.source: Pilot’s Notes AN 01-60JE-1 and calculated sheet (wwiiaircraftperformance.org)
p51d.notes: Scales with sqrt(W); ~94-101 mph at 9000 lb

p47d.notes: 116 mph idling at 13230 lb; small CAS correction

bf109g2.notes: IAS only; no primary CAS table

spitfire1.notes: Very low for early production weights

spitfire5.source: NACA 'Stalling Characteristics of the Supermarine Spitfire VA Airplane' (Vensel & Phillips, 1942)
spitfire5.notes: Good buffet warning; time histories available; higher than Mk I

bf109e.notes: Slats open ~20 mph above stall; half-fuel load

gaps: No clean CAS/EAS stall numbers at matched mass for any of the eight
Spitfire I full stall table still sparse
